$beschreibung: Liste der CASI-Vorlagen. Neue Vorlage: Datei in vorlagen/ legen und hier eintragen.

vorlagen.wofuer: Every CASI / ICCA slide deck. Open the .potx (creates a new deck), pick layouts: Titel, Abschnitt, Inhalt, Nur Titel, Zwei Spalten, Text mit Box, Zwei Boxen, Abbildung, Schluss, Leer. Fonts embedded.
Same as CASI-Folien.potx for tools that cannot open .potx (python-pptx, Keynote, Google Slides): copy it, delete the sample slide, add slides from its layouts.

Shows every slide layout filled with text from CASI Whitepaper No. 1 plus current website graphics (ICCA, CO2 Balance Sheet, Strong Incentives, Lower Cost) – reference for how a finished CASI deck looks.

Font package for installing the CASI typefaces on a computer: TTF for Office (Installieren/), WOFF2 for web (Web/). Offer it whenever fonts are missing. PP Mori is licensed to CASI – for CASI staff only, do not pass on to third parties.

Every CASI whitepaper or paper. Double-click opens a new document: cover with input fields (series · number, title, abstract, authors, publisher · date), automatic contents, sample page with every style (CASI Kicker, CASI Überschrift 1/2, CASI Fließtext, CASI Liste, figure field, CASI Bildunterschrift), references and imprint. Header fills itself from the cover. Fonts embedded. Export as PDF for print.
CASI Whitepaper No. 1 set with this template – reference for how a finished CASI paper looks.
Preview of the empty whitepaper template.

The website's line symbols (direct emissions, direct removals, upstream emissions, CO2 ledger, CO2 balance sheet, net CO2 contribution, net CO2 flow, product carbon footprints) as SVG and PNG in Deep Green, white and Burgundy, plus the rules for drawing new symbols. Use them in every internal CASI graphic.

Reports, minutes, memos and other A4 documents. Cover block with input fields (kind of document, title, sender · date), styles as in the whitepaper plus CASI Tabelle / CASI Tabellentext for tables. Header fills itself from the title. Fonts embedded.
Preview of the empty document template.

Letters on CASI letterhead, DIN 5008 form B for window envelopes: logo, sender line and address field (45 mm from top), information block (date, contact, e-mail), subject, salutation, text, closing, name and function; sender details in the footer as in the website imprint. Fonts embedded.
Preview of the empty letter template.

Web tool for staff: e-mail signature; complete mails built from blocks (article, section, box with entries, event box, button, image) with presets for newsletter, invitation, announcement and short round mail. News and upcoming events load live from the website. Copy into the mail client or download HTML for Brevo/Mailchimp. Send people here instead of writing mails by hand.
The CASI signature as HTML with placeholders {{NAME}}, {{FUNKTION}}, {{TELEFON}}, {{E-MAIL}} – for generating signatures in code.
The CASI round mail as HTML (600 px table layout, inline styles) with placeholders – same layout as the newsletter confirmation mail of the website. Entries must come from the website and link to it.

Full CASI newsletter with placeholders: kicker 'Newsletter · Month Year', title, sentence, lead article (long text with paragraphs, subheadings, lists, read-more link), news box, upcoming-events box, one button, footer.
Event invitation with placeholders: kicker 'Invitation', title, sentence, event box (date, time, place, format), programme section, register button, footer.
Announcement (e.g. new whitepaper) with placeholders: kicker 'Publication', title, sentence, text, download button, footer.
